The '''''Temblor''''' was a primitive [[Boat/Legends|sailing ship]]<ref name="negtc" /> from<ref name="CSWE Temblor">{{CSWECite|III|229|''Temblor''}}</ref> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wroona/Legends|Wroona]].<ref name="Wroona">{{CSWECite|III|336|Wroona}}</ref> Between [[72 BBY/Legends|72 BBY]] and [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]],<ref name="Date">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']], states that [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] was born in [[72 BBY/Legends|72 BBY]], and {{StarshipsVehiclesCite|25|Welcome On Board}} states that he had achieved the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] by the age of 28, which correspond to [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]]. Therefore, Windu's [[Time/Legends|time]] as a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] and service aboard the ''Temblor'' as established by ''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]'' must have taken place between those [[Standard year/Legends|years]].</ref> the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] served a tour aboard the ''Temblor''<ref name="negtc" /> on Wroona's vast [[Water/Legends|oceans]],<ref name="Wroona" /> where he fought against [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]].<ref name="negtc" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Temblor'' was first mentioned in the [[2002]] reference book ''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]'' written by [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="negtc" />
